title: Full-Stack Developer — Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, AI-assisted development
seniority: At least 3 years of professional full-stack development
description: Build, test, and support full-stack product features using Node.js, React.js, and TypeScript. Required evidence includes at least three years of professional full-stack work; practical Node.js with Express, NestJS, or a comparable framework; React Hooks, state management, component design, responsive UI development, and performance awareness; TypeScript; REST API design; SQL and NoSQL data stores such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis; Git branching; CI/CD; automated tests; maintainable code; and production debugging. Equivalent practical experience or a strong delivery portfolio may substitute for a related bachelor's degree.
